title: PepLab Bench: reusable source-model-selector peptide replay
description: Portable integration contracts and saved-result explorer accompanying a complete 30,200-episode development replay on 160 archived HLA-A*02:01 nine-mers. Original numerical functions are AST-preserved; portable adapters are contract-tested and a clean noneditable public installation reproduced 12 selected historical episodes (36 contexts), with exact selected identities/order and recovery counts. This is not a full 30,200-episode rerun. No new independent biological validation. No pretrained weights or third-party runtime binaries bundled.
